title: Finch Circle Program Rule — Returned Share and the Courtesy Note's Validity
content:
**Rule.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the courtesy returned share is the qualifying amount on return deduction entries dated within the last 12 whole months, as a percent of the qualifying amount on purchase points entries dated within those months. The courtesy returned-share method is the halving method when the courtesy returned share is 40 percent or more, the reduction method when it is 25 percent or more but less than 40 percent, and the standard method otherwise.

Under the halving method the courtesy validity days are half the courtesy day count, rounded down to whole days; under the reduction method they are the courtesy day count less 5; under the standard method they are the courtesy day count.

Both qualifying amounts are read from the membership's own points history, by entry date, within the last 12 whole months.

| Courtesy returned share | Method | Courtesy validity days |
|---|---|---|
| 40 percent or more | halving | half the courtesy day count, rounded down to whole days |
| 25 percent or more but less than 40 percent | reduction | the courtesy day count less 5 |
| less than 25 percent | standard | the courtesy day count |

## Worked figures (hypothetical; courtesy day count 31)

| Qualifying amount on purchase points entries in 12 months | On return deduction entries | Returned share | Method | Courtesy validity days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2,000.00 | 800.00 | 40 percent | halving | 15 |
| 2,000.00 | 600.00 | 30 percent | reduction | 26 |
| 2,000.00 | 499.00 | 24.95 percent | standard | 31 |
